offerings.name: Google Search API
offerings.pricing: Starter: $50 for 50k credits ($1.00/1k); Standard: $375 for 500k credits ($0.75/1k); Scale: $1250 for 2.5M credits ($0.50/1k); Ultimate: $3750 for 12.5M credits ($0.30/1k). Excluding sales tax/VAT/GST.
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries. No credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 结构化 Google SERP 搜索结果（JSON），包括 organic、knowledgeGraph、peopleAlsoAsk、relatedSearches 等；亦支持 Images、News、Maps、Places、Videos、Shopping、Scholar、Patents、Autocomplete。
offerings.note: 成功响应时扣 credits；每次 API 调用直接查询 Google，不缓存，返回最新 SERP 结果；credits 有效期 6 个月。
